verdict.rationale: Gumloop supports Connectors for third-party integrations (e.g. Gmail, Salesforce, Slack) and Organization Skills that let admins control who can use shared resources, implying some centralized credential/permission management, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated credential vault, team-wide sharing of specific connector credentials, or granular per-credential access control for ops users. missing for 10: explicit credential storage/vault documentation, granular per-credential sharing controls, and evidence of ops-specific credential governance UI or audit logs.
